title: sched/pthread/join: refactor pthread join to support join task
problem_statement: POSIX requires pthread_join() on a detached or already-joined thread to return EINVAL. The base kernel returns ESRCH instead. This 17-file refactor introduces sched/task/task_join.c as a dedicated join-task abstraction and rewires pthread_join(), pthread_detach(), pthread_completejoin(), pthread_findjoininfo(), and pthread_release() so that joining a detached thread correctly returns EINVAL. Apps PR #2329 updates cancel_test in testing/ostest/cancel.c to assert EINVAL (not ESRCH). On the base kernel, cancel_test prints 'ERROR pthread_join failed but with wrong status=3' — the test fails to reach its PASS line.
fail_reason: cancel_test detects wrong errno from pthread_join on detached thread: ESRCH(3) returned, EINVAL(22) expected
fail_to_pass: cancel_test: PASS pthread_join failed with status=EINVAL
ostest completes and exits with status 0
pass_to_pass: NuttX boots and NSH prompt appears
